summary: The exact candidate fixes both parts of the original implementation contract: VisionTritonAttention forwards window_size and s_aux, and the Triton prefill kernel applies local-window masking plus value-less per-head sink logits in the online-softmax denominator. The recorded base reproduced silent kwarg dropping; candidate and independent GPU numerical tests passed.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction on the actual vision backend and Triton kernel: backend outputs ignored changed window/sink kwargs and direct kernel calls rejected window_size/sinks. The legacy full-attention controls passed.

Candidate regression suite: 13 tests passed for backend propagation, window-only, sink-only, combined behavior, GQA, ragged batches, multi-block lengths, causal composition, validation, and reference calibration; one FA3 test skipped because FA3 is unavailable on ROCm.

tests.command: Independent inline PyTorch-reference adversarial matrix recorded in raw/independent-adversarial.log (at candidate d2d2311e20870d102ed6f8cfbfd1328c8d0fe05d)
tests.what_was_measured: Five real-GPU numerical comparisons across lengths 1/17/33/65/127/129/130/255/257, GQA ratios, head dimensions 32/64/80/128, BF16 and FP32, causal/asymmetric/zero/full windows, and extreme positive/negative sinks; all matched an independent torch.softmax reference without NaNs.

gpu_execution.evidence: Candidate regression and independent numerical kernels executed on one AMD Instinct MI355X with gfx950:sramecc+:xnack- under Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2.

remaining_limitations: No MiMo model weights were available; full model/server output quality was not evaluated.
The assigned device was AMD gfx950/ROCm 7.2, not the reported NVIDIA B40/H20 CUDA systems; CUDA/NVIDIA compilation was not executed.
FA3 is unavailable in this ROCm environment, so its optional on-device cross-backend comparison skipped.
Only a single GPU was used; no distributed or multi-node claim is made.
